title: heliamphora glabra
intro: Heliamphora glabra, commonly known as the smooth sun pitcher, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the Droseraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits associated with Heliamphora glabra include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Heliamphora glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
